railingDefaults.rule: Follow the D4 specification; starting preset T-top 2x6 flat cap with round black aluminum balusters (D-01), in-deck posts (D-02).

deckingDefaults.rule: New deck: no brand, collection or color preselected. James chooses brand, then collection, then color before preview.

deckingRules.Q02: James chooses a color before preview; no automatic first or last-used color.
deckingRules.Q03: Group by the brand's real material/product families (TimberTech: Advanced PVC / Composite), then collection. No invented categories.
deckingRules.Q04: No favorites or recent list; full verified catalog.
deckingRules.Q05: Auto-select a compatible board profile for each role (field, border, divider, stair, fascia); James can review.
deckingRules.Q06: Single picture-frame border by default on NEW decks only, rendered only with compatible boards. Saved decks unchanged.
deckingRules.Q07: Picture frame starts matching the main deck color; compatible contrast allowed.
deckingRules.Q08: Dividers start matching the field color; compatible contrast allowed; divider count and locations preserved.
deckingRules.Q09: Fascia starts matching the selected collection/color, only where a real matching fascia exists.
deckingRules.Q10: James chooses a compatible stair tread color per staircase; options are the main deck color or the picture-frame color where the product exists.
deckingRules.Q11: Closed risers default to the main deck color where a matching riser exists; picture-frame color also offered.
deckingRules.Q12: Attached landings inherit the main decking, with independent override; landing geometry preserved.
deckingRules.Q13: Product/color selection first; profile-driven board layout and quantities in a later tested phase. No silent quantity or board-width changes.
deckingRules.Q14: When the main decking changes, ask whether to keep or replace border/divider color overrides. Never alter geometry, stairs or placement.
deckingRules.Q15: Approximate color previews allowed if clearly labeled; replace with measured/licensed assets when available.
deckingRules.Q16: Customer concept PDF: manufacturer, collection, color and visual only; no preliminary quantities. Internal estimating independent.

customerPdfPolicy.internalOutputsUnaffected: Takeoffs, material calculations and production exports stay in internal/construction outputs (developer to confirm at integration).
